;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Oromo–Somali clashes]]
**The death toll from the recent spike in ethnic violence in [[Ethiopia]] rises to 58. Thousands are still protesting against the killings in the capital [[Addis Ababa]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/toll-ethiopia-bloodshed-least-58-rights-group-source-152604375.html?guccounter=1 (Yahoo News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Hurricane Florence]] 
**The death toll rises to 37 after two mental health patients died when the police van in which they were being transported got caught in floodwaters. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45577071 (BBC)]
*[[Storm Ali]]
**Two people are killed by Storm Ali as it brings winds of up to {{convert|160|kph}} in [[Ireland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45572946 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Kidnapping of Elizabeth Smart]]
**After serving fifteen years behind bars for her role in the kidnapping, Wanda Barzee, is released on probation from Utah State Prison. She will be on probation for five years. [https://www.usmagazine.com/celebrity-news/news/elizabeth-smarts-kidnapper-wanda-barzee-released-from-prison/ (''Us Weekly'')]
*[[Killing of Mollie Tibbetts]]
**Cristhian Bahena Rivera, a 24-year-old man charged in the killing of [[University of Iowa]] student Mollie Tibbetts, is expected to be arraigned in a [[Poweshiek County, Iowa|Poweshiek County]] court. [http://www.kcrg.com/content/news/Arraignment-for-man-charged-in-Mollie-Tibbetts-death-to-be-held-today-493712741.html (KCRG-TV)]
*[[Panama Papers case]]
**[[Islamabad High Court]] suspends the [[National Accountability Bureau|NAB]] accountability court sentences and orders the release of former Pakistani Prime Minister [[Nawaz Sharif]], his daughter [[Maryam Nawaz]], and son-in-law [[Muhammad Safdar Awan]]. However, the convictions remain standing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/pakistan-court-frees-pm-nawaz-sharif-daughter-180919102546688.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia]], [[Najib Razak]], is arrested in connection with the allegation that [[Malaysian ringgit|RM]]2.6 billion (US$681 million when first reported three years ago) went into his personal bank accounts. New charges are, once approved, due to be filed tomorrow. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/ousted-malaysian-leader-najib-arrested-to-face-new-charges-in-1mdb-scandal-1537350993 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*An arrest warrant is issued in [[Texas]] for [[3D printed firearms|3D-printed gun]] rights activist and [[Defense Distributed]] owner [[Cody Wilson]] in connection with the sexual assault of a child. Wilson was last known to be in [[Taiwan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/cody-wilson-owner-3d-printed-gun-company-wanted/story?id=57933393 (ABC News)] [https://gizmodo.com/3d-printed-gun-activist-cody-wilson-charged-with-sexual-1829168263 (Gizmodo)]
*[[Gun violence in the United States]]
**An employee at a software firm in [[Middleton, Wisconsin]], opens fire on his coworkers, injuring three, before being fatally wounded by police. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/19/us/wisconsin-active-shooter-report/index.html (CNN)]
**Four people are wounded in a shooting at a [[courthouse]] in [[Masontown, Pennsylvania]], before police fatally shoot the gunman. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/19/us/pennsylvania-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
**A gunman upset from his divorce shoots and wounds his ex-wife, then fatally shoots his parents in a [[Retirement|retirement]] home in [[Chester County, Pennsylvania]]. The suspect later is found dead in his van after a brief [[shootout]] with police. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2018/09/20/pennsylvania-gunman-upset-over-divorce-kills-parents-found-dead/1366120002/ (''USA Today'')]
*Three people are injured after a car [[Vehicle-ramming attack|rammed into pedestrians]] near a mosque in northwest [[London]]. The [[Metropolitan Police Service|Metropolitan Police]] are treating the incident as a hate crime. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/injured-car-rams-people-london-mosque-180919082742677.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]], [[2018 in spaceflight]]
**[[NASA]] discovers its first [[exoplanet]] via the [[Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite]] space telescope. [[Pi Mensae#Planetary system|Pi Mensae c]], a small [[Earth-like planet|Earth-like]] exoplanet, is located nearly 60 light-years away from [[Earth]]. [https://gizmodo.com/nasa-s-tess-space-telescope-has-spotted-its-first-exopl-1829165207 (Gizmodo)]
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]], [[Stars and planetary systems in fiction#40 (ο²) Eridani (Keid)|Stars and planetary systems in fiction]]
**Astronomers discover an exoplanet located in the [[40 Eridani]] star system mentioned in the ''[[Star Trek]]'' series where the planet [[Vulcan (Star Trek)#Homeworld|Vulcan]] is located. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/davidbressan/2018/09/19/astronomers-discover-real-life-planet-vulcan-homeworld-of-mister-spock-in-the-star-trek-universe/#2955681e7347 (''Forbes'')] [https://www.syfy.com/syfywire/exoplanet-news-astronomers-have-found-vulcan (Syfy)]
